review_evidence: README identifies Skimmer as Lean tooling that captures and persists linter executions and file-ending/process data that are normally ephemeral.

The Skimmer/SkimmerHub/WorkingTest Lean sources define the tool’s extensions, serialization, execution, refactoring and regression behavior; test-named formal modules are retained because they exercise those interfaces.

Unlike ordinary build-only lakefiles, complete inspection of this repository’s lakefile.lean shows substantial project-specific Lean/Lake implementation: EditData, transitive-import fetching, custom module/package facets, module parsing/elaboration and inline_modules behavior. It is therefore retained.
summary: Retain the full Skimmer Lean tooling corpus, including its substantively implemented lakefile and working tests.
